name: @adrw/fiber-extension
description: A framework chrome extensions foundation for nicer developer experience

tasks.build: rm -rf dist && deno run -A npm:typescript/tsc && cp -r src/types dist/
tasks.typecheck: deno check src/index.ts src/runtime/*.ts src/vite/*.ts e2e/*.ts e2e/tests/*.ts e2e/fixtures/test-extension/src/*.ts e2e/fixtures/test-extension/*.ts
